mechanism: Exposure-amortized trust from exposure_trust plus multiplicity-averaged sampled-latent gradients: multiply each sample backward by (batch/particles)/number of occurrences of that index. This keeps the expected table-gradient scale while removing duplicate-index weighting.
rationale: Exposure trust restores rare shape (eigen .664; sustained suffix 6) but ring remains seven. Ring uses a tiny table with repeated indices; remove batch multiplicity fluctuations before Adam while retaining sparse-table travel budgets. Prior multiplicity alone also left ring at seven; this is a declared coupled update refinement, not its replay.
optimizer_updates: One D plus one G/particle update per frozen iteration; particle custom update substitutes original Adam table update.
extra_work: Exposure-trust reductions plus sampled-index counting and one backward elementwise rescaling. No extra forwards/backwards/optimizer updates; equal-step only.
